text:
Hello, I’m new here and I hope someone can help me with my situation.

I am currently working as a B1 caregiving visa here in Israel. We started processing (unmarried couple visa) my application last Sunday, but unfortunately, my employer passed away on the same day.

My current visa is valid until July 2, and my work visa status has been changed to registered reliever status until October. So far, I have not been able to find a permanent employer.

I would like to ask:

1. Can I return to the Philippines while waiting for my interview?
2. If I stay in Israel after July 2 and wait for the interview, what will my legal status be?
3. Do I need to apply for a visa extension or any other permit while waiting?

I would greatly appreciate any advice or information. Thank you very much 🙏🏻
